title: Vortex matter as a magnetically programmable metasurface for tuning near-field radiative heat transfer
abstract: Near-field radiative heat transfer (NFRHT) is of great interest for energy conversion and thermal management. Recent work on NFRHT has shown that metasurfaces can enhance NFRHT and reshape its spectral characteristics. Here, we show that the vortex lattice of a type-II superconductor represents a self-assembled metasurface whose lattice dimensions, in contrast to most other metasurfaces, can be tuned by magnetic fields, allowing NFRHT to be varied by orders of magnitude. Specifically, we show that for two Nb surfaces at 4.2 K and separated by a 100 nm gap, NFRHT can be magnetically tuned by a factor >200. Further, we show that the tuning range grows upon cooling, exceeding 10^5 at 2 K, which is far beyond the order-unity modulation of many proposed schemes for tuning NFRHT. Our results establish vortex matter as a magnetically programmable thermal metasurface and open new opportunities for tuning the flow of heat at the nanoscale.

title: Achieving ultrahigh-temperature superfluidity in atomic Fermi gases by suppressing pairing fluctuations
abstract: Achieving room-temperature superconductivity has been a long-sought goal of both the physics community and the industry. The superfluid transition temperature $T_\mathrm{c}$ of a Fermi system initially increases with increasing pairing strength between fermions following the mean-field prediction of the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) theory, and is then suppressed by pairing fluctuations as the strength increases further, which prevents $T_\mathrm{c}$ from becoming high. Here we propose a mechanism for suppressing pairing fluctuations using the synergy between population imbalance and momentum space confinement in lattice systems, enabling an ultrahigh $T_\mathrm{c}$ at moderately strong attraction. We show that in a three-dimensional optical lattice, strong Pauli exclusion between paired and excess majority fermions pushes up the pair excitation energy and suppresses finite-momentum pairing fluctuations. The mechanism is general to any lattice with a finite Brillouin zone; the optimal imbalance is modest ($p\lesssim 0.1$), keeping the Zeeman field small and avoiding orbital complications. The gapped pair dispersion at moderate imbalance exponentially suppresses thermal condensate depletion, providing a testable signature. The gapped dispersion, enhanced condensate fraction, and pseudogap reduction are all accessible in present-day experiments. This work opens new avenues toward room-temperature superconductivity.

summaries.en: The authors propose that combining population imbalance with momentum-space confinement in a three-dimensional optical lattice suppresses finite-momentum pairing fluctuations through Pauli exclusion between paired and excess majority fermions, enabling ultrahigh superfluid transition temperatures at moderately strong attraction.

title: Stacking-Induced Tuning of a Flat-Band Surface State in NbIrTe4
abstract: Ternary layered transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) offer high tunability and access to correlated and topological states. However, like the broader family of layered TMDCs, their properties are sensitive to stacking order and interlayer coupling. Here, we investigate the electronic structure and surface states of NbIrTe$_4$, a candidate Weyl semimetal in bulk, and predicted to be a quantum spin Hall insulator in monolayer form. Using scanning tunnelling microscopy (STM), angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), and density-functional theory (DFT), we attribute the strong resonance in tunnelling spectroscopy located approximately 8 meV below the Fermi level to a surface-derived flat band which shows sensitivity to the local stacking order at the surface. In regions where the top layer is laterally shifted, tunnelling spectroscopy instead shows a gap-like feature with intensity near the Fermi level shifted in energy. Combining DFT and quasiparticle interference (QPI) measurements, we find this dramatic change in the spectroscopy in the vicinity of the quasi-1D flat-band surface state becomes dispersive due to a change in the spatial distribution of the density of states in the top two layers. These findings establish NbIrTe$_4$ as a platform where surface band dispersion can be effectively tuned through local structural manipulation.
subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)

summaries.en: Using STM, ARPES, and DFT, the authors show that a flat-band surface state about 8 meV below the Fermi level in NbIrTe4 is sensitive to local stacking order, becoming dispersive when the top layer is laterally shifted.

title: Diffusive Description of Superconducting Single-Photon Detectors Using Quantum Mechanics
abstract: The methodology of non-Hermitian quantum mechanics is employed to parameterize the dynamics of coupled classical diffusion equations describing low- and high-energy quasiparticles in superconducting single-photon detectors in one to three spatial dimensions.

summaries.en: Non-Hermitian quantum mechanics is used to parameterize the dynamics of coupled classical diffusion equations describing low- and high-energy quasiparticles in superconducting single-photon detectors in one to three spatial dimensions.

title: Nanocrystalline cubic boron arsenide growth on GaAs(100) by gas source molecular beam epitaxy
abstract: Cubic boron arsenide (c-BAs) is a promising ultrahigh thermal conductivity semiconductor, but its direct synthesis on lattice-mismatched substrates remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate the synthesis of nanocrystalline c-BAs thin films on GaAs(100) substrates using gas source molecular beam epitaxy. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals an optimal growth temperature window of 250-400 C to maintain near stoichiometry and suppress severe arsenic loss. Surface and structural characterizations via atomic force microscopy, reflection high-energy electron diffraction, and grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction demonstrate a Volmer-Weber 3D island growth mode and a preferential crystallographic alignment with the GaAs substrate. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy confirms a chemically sharp interface without gallium interdiffusion into the c-BAs layer. These findings establish an initial step for the integration of c-BAs into advanced thermal and optoelectronic platforms.

summaries.en: Nanocrystalline cubic boron arsenide films were grown on lattice-mismatched GaAs(100) substrates by gas source molecular beam epitaxy within a 250-400 °C window that maintains near stoichiometry, exhibiting Volmer-Weber three-dimensional island growth with a chemically sharp interface.
summaries.zh: 采用气源分子束外延在晶格失配的GaAs(100)衬底上生长了纳米晶立方砷化硼薄膜，在250-400°C窗口内保持近化学计量比，呈现Volmer-Weber三维岛状生长并具有化学上陡峭的界面。

title: Charge-conserving creation and annihilation of topological phase singularities in atomically thin semiconductors
abstract: Atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides provide a promising material platform for optical phase manipulation, as rapid variations in their dielectric functions can give rise to topological phase singularities (PSs). However, PS evolution while preserving topological charge conservation has not yet been investigated in exciton enabled PS systems. Here, using atomically thin MoS2 films on sapphire as a model system, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate that the evolution of dielectric dispersion determines the creation, trajectory, merging, and annihilation of optical PSs under topological charge conservation. By varying the MoS2 film thickness, we experimentally realize this evolution through the gradual shrinking of the high energy n-k dispersion loop, which modifies its intersection with the zero reflection condition. Our results provide a general strategy for exploring and manipulating topological optical states.

summaries.en: Using atomically thin MoS2 films on sapphire, this study theoretically and experimentally shows that the evolution of dielectric dispersion governs the creation, trajectory, merging, and annihilation of optical phase singularities while conserving topological charge, with film thickness tuning the intersection of the high-energy n-k dispersion loop with the zero-reflection condition.
summaries.zh: 本研究以蓝宝石衬底上的原子级薄MoS2薄膜为模型体系，从理论和实验上证明介电色散的演化决定了光学相位奇点的产生、轨迹、合并与湮灭并保持拓扑荷守恒，且通过改变MoS2薄膜厚度使高能n-k色散环逐渐收缩从而调控其与零反射条件的交点。
summaries.ja: サファイア上の原子層MoS2薄膜をモデル系として用い、本研究は誘電分散の変化がトポロジカル電荷を保存しつつ光学位相特異点の生成・軌道・合流・消滅を決定することを理論と実験の両面で示し、MoS2膜厚の変化により高エネルギーn-k分散ループを徐々に縮小させてゼロ反射条件との交点を変調することでこれを実現した。

title: A high-speed, large-aperture 3D printed laser shutter for cold atom experiments
abstract: Cold atom experiments require optical shutters with rapid and repeatable actuation. Existing solutions often involve high cost, limited aperture diameter and slow transitioning. We present a 3D-printable shutter design featuring a large aperture of 4.5 mm diameter, low-cost assembly, and robust performance. The device achieves switching times of $399\pm8~\mu$s with delays of $2.7\pm0.2$ ms for a fully illuminated aperture, with four different shutters demonstrating repeatable performance. We measure the shutter speed to be $7.0\pm0.1$ m/s. This approach offers an accessible, scalable solution for cold atom and other optical experiments requiring multiple shutters with precise light control and avoids the need to resize or precision-align a beam through an aperture.

title: Atomic identification via the Prandtl-Tomlinson stick-slip mechanism
abstract: Distinguishing atomic species is an ongoing challenge in the field of scanning probe microscopy. Typically, atomic force microscopy makes use of electrostatic interactions to perform atomic identification. Here we perform lateral force microscopy (LFM) measurements with a CO terminated tip of a partially oxidized Cu(110) surface and show clear differences between the metal and oxygen sites over a large z-range. This allows for atomic identification on a typical metal oxide. Density functional theory based calculations show that the tip-sample interaction is dominated by short-ranged orbital interactions and that the electrostatic contribution is negligible. At small tip-sample distances, LFM can probe the Prandtl-Tomlinson stick-slip mechanism on the single-atom scale. It is visible as a striking asymmetry in the forward and backward scan directions, experimentally revealing this fundamental model for nanotribology on the single-atom scale.

summaries.en: Lateral force microscopy with a CO-terminated tip on partially oxidized Cu(110) distinguishes metal from oxygen sites over a large z-range, with density functional theory showing the interaction is dominated by short-range orbital effects rather than electrostatics and that at small tip-sample distances the Prandtl-Tomlinson stick-slip mechanism becomes visible as a pronounced asymmetry between forward and backward scans.

title: Moments of Random Permanents and Hafnians: A Replica Approach
abstract: Using contour-integral representations of the permanent and of the Hafnian, we turn the computation of their moments for random matrices into a replica calculation, analogous to that of the moments of the partition function of a mean-field spin glass. For the $2k$-th moment of $N\times N$ matrices with independent entries, the dominant saddle point is replica symmetric for $k>2$, and we obtain in closed form the exponential growth rate, the prefactor and the first $1/N$ correction, in agreement with exact enumerations. The growth rate depends only on whether the entries are real or complex; higher cumulants affect only the prefactor and the $1/N$ term. At $k=2$ the replica-symmetric solution becomes unstable, separating a power-law bulk of the distribution from a large-deviation tail, which we compute. The results apply to boson sampling with single photons and with squeezed light.

summaries.en: Using contour-integral representations, the authors turn the computation of moments of random permanents and hafnians into a replica calculation whose dominant saddle point is replica symmetric for k>2, yielding closed-form exponential growth rate, prefactor, and first 1/N correction that agree with exact enumerations and apply to boson sampling with single photons and squeezed light.

title: Tracking multiscale liquid crystal order with high harmonic spectroscopy
abstract: Can high-harmonic generation track how microscopic intermolecular interactions give rise to macroscopic order? We address this question in the thermotropic liquid crystal 4-cyano-4'-n-pentylbiphenyl, a model system with a well-defined nematic-to-isotropic transition. Using a temperature-controlled flat jet, we show that polarization-resolved high-harmonic generation driven by mid-infrared strong-field pulses is highly sensitive to liquid-crystal order. In the nematic phase, the harmonic yield forms a four-lobed angular pattern with twofold rotational symmetry and is strongest when the driving-field polarization is perpendicular to the molecular director; this anisotropy vanishes in the isotropic liquid. A tight-binding model parameterized by first-principles calculations attributes this response to intermolecular orbital hybridization in short-range antiparallel molecular arrangements. Temperature-dependent measurements across multiple harmonic orders resolve the same first-order phase transition, with each harmonic order exhibiting a distinct optical sensitivity. A multiscale model combining the microscopic response, Landau-de Gennes orientational correlations and phase matching explains this behaviour through the interplay between orientational correlation lengths and harmonic coherence lengths. High-harmonic generation therefore links local electronic coupling to mesoscopic order and macroscopic propagation, providing an all-optical probe of multiscale organization in soft matter.

summaries.en: Polarization-resolved high-harmonic generation in the thermotropic liquid crystal 5CB tracks the nematic-to-isotropic transition, with a four-lobed twofold-symmetric harmonic angular pattern strongest for polarization perpendicular to the director that vanishes in the isotropic phase, attributed by a first-principles-parameterized tight-binding model to intermolecular orbital hybridization in short-range antiparallel arrangements and explained across harmonic orders by a multiscale model coupling microscopic response, Landau-de Gennes orientational correlations, and phase matching.
summaries.zh: 在热致液晶5CB中，偏振分辨的高次谐波产生能够追踪从向列相到各向同性相的转变，谐波产额呈现四瓣、二重旋转对称的角分布，且当驱动场偏振垂直于指向矢时最强，并在各向同性相中消失，第一性原理参数化的紧束缚模型将其归因于短程反平行分子排列中的分子间轨道杂化，而结合微观响应、Landau-de Gennes取向关联与相位匹配的多尺度模型则解释了不同谐波阶次的行为。
summaries.ja: 熱性液晶5CBにおいて、偏光分解高調波発生はネマチック―等方相転移を追跡でき、駆動場偏光がダイレクターに垂直なときに最も強くなる四葉で二回回転対称な高調波角度パターンが等方相では消失し、第一原理計算でパラメータ化した強結合モデルがこれを短距離反平行分子配置における分子間軌道混成に帰し、微視的応答・Landau-de Gennes配向相関・位相整合を結合したマルチスケールモデルが各高調波次数の挙動を説明する。

title: Density Saturation and Autocorrelation Characteristics of Interlayer Exciton Ensembles in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ Heterostructures
abstract: We investigate interlayer excitons in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterostructures using time-resolved photoluminescence and second-order autocorrelation measurements across a wide range of excitation powers and bath temperatures. By analyzing the photoluminescence amplitude and lifetime of the interlayer exciton state with the lowest emission energy, we extract a corresponding density-temperature diagram. The extracted exciton density exhibits a saturation at approximately $10^{13}$cm$^{-2}$, consistent with values predicted for a Mott transition of interlayer exciton ensembles in van der Waals heterostructures. Moreover, possible interpretations beyond the Mott transition are discussed. We further test whether the density limit is accompanied by a departure from classical photon statistics. The second-order autocorrelation measurements reveal that the photoluminescence maintains an emission characteristic of $g^{(2)}(0) \approx 1$ from low exciton densities up to the maximum reachable density in the investigated exciton ensembles consistent with the lowest-energy exciton ensemble obeying Poissonian statistics.

summaries.en: Time-resolved photoluminescence and second-order autocorrelation measurements of interlayer excitons in MoSe2/WSe2 heterostructures reveal a density saturation near 10^13 cm^-2, consistent with a Mott transition, while the emission retains g^(2)(0) ≈ 1 up to the maximum reachable density, indicating Poissonian statistics.
summaries.zh: 对MoSe2/WSe2异质结构中层间激子的时间分辨光致发光和二阶自相关测量显示，激子密度在约10^13 cm^-2处饱和，与莫特转变的预测一致，同时光致发光在可达的最大密度范围内保持g^(2)(0) ≈ 1，表明其符合泊松统计。

title: Dramatic pressure-induced slowdown and the soft glassy rheology of water at 2D material interface
abstract: The flow of molecularly confined water has attracted considerable interest in recent years. Yet despite their exquisite character, current nanofluidic devices cannot probe molecular water flow beyond the linear-response regime, while nanomechanical force- based approaches have produced markedly inconsistent results. Here, using tuning- fork-based atomic force microscopy, we tackle these limitations by measuring the full linear-to-nonlinear, shear-dependent viscoelastic rheology of molecularly confined water at various two-dimensional material interfaces -- demonstrating pronounced rate effects in water flow response. The observed rheological behaviors are remarkably analogous to that of macroscopic soft glassy yielding materials and fully captured by a non-linear model accounting for the shear-induced acceleration of the dynamics -- a hallmark of disordered supercooled and metastable systems. We further unveil a pronounced pressure-induced slowdown in nanoconfined water dynamics, with relaxation times extending into the microsecond range and marked material dependence. These results reveal non-linear, glassy rheology as a general feature of interfacial water and offer a route to tunable, non-linear nanofluidic elements.
subjects: Soft Condensed Matter (cond-mat.soft) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Fluid Dynamics (physics.flu-dyn)

summaries.en: Using tuning-fork-based atomic force microscopy, the study measured the full linear-to-nonlinear shear-dependent viscoelastic rheology of molecularly confined water at various two-dimensional material interfaces, revealing soft glassy yielding behavior, shear-induced acceleration of dynamics, and a pronounced pressure-induced slowdown with relaxation times extending into the microsecond range and marked material dependence.

title: Dynamics of two bosons with density-assisted tunnelling in a one-dimensional tilted lattice
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of two bosons in a tilted one-dimensional optical lattice with both standard and density-assisted tunnelling. The relative sign of the two tunnelling processes strongly affects the Bloch dynamics, leading to distinct reinforcing and competing regimes. We examine how the tunnelling processes generate correlations and find that, in the absence of onsite interactions, the early-time entanglement growth follows the same scaling with the density-assisted tunnelling amplitude. Finite onsite interaction changes this picture by breaking the symmetry between the reinforcing and competing regimes and enhancing the correlation differently in two regimes. This shows how the interplay between the two tunnelling mechanisms can change dyanmics and entanglement in a controlled few-body setting. Particularly, at equal tunnelling amplitudes, the doublon and singlon sectors decouple completely for arbitrary onsite interaction, lattice tilting, and initial state.

summaries.en: This study shows that the relative sign of standard and density-assisted tunnelling in a tilted one-dimensional lattice produces reinforcing versus competing Bloch dynamics for two bosons, that early-time entanglement growth scales with the density-assisted tunnelling amplitude in the absence of onsite interactions, and that onsite interactions break this symmetry and enhance correlations differently, with the doublon and singlon sectors decoupling completely at equal tunnelling amplitudes for arbitrary interactions, tilting, and initial states.
summaries.zh: 本研究揭示，在一维倾斜晶格中，标准隧穿与密度辅助隧穿的相对符号会使两个玻色子呈现增强或竞争两种不同的布洛赫动力学；无在位相互作用时，早期纠缠增长随密度辅助隧穿幅度以相同规律标度，而在位相互作用会打破两种情形间的对称性并以不同方式增强关联，且当两种隧穿幅度相等时，对于任意的在位相互作用、晶格倾斜和初始态，双占位与单占位子空间完全解耦。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、一次元傾斜格子における標準トンネリングと密度支援トンネリングの相対符号が2個のボソンのブロッホダイナミクスを増強型と競合型に分岐させること、オンサイト相互作用がない場合の初期のエンタングルメント成長が密度支援トンネリング振幅と同じスケーリングに従うこと、オンサイト相互作用がこの対称性を破って両領域で相関を異なる形で増強すること、そして等しいトンネリング振幅では任意のオンサイト相互作用・格子傾斜・初期状態に対してダブロンとシングロンのセクターが完全に分離することを示す。

title: Steady-state cooperative emission of interlayer excitons in atomically thin light-emitting diodes
abstract: When an ensemble of emitters is confined within an optical wavelength, its radiation can become correlated, leading to cooperative emission. In two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) electron-hole bilayers, strong light-matter coupling enables the formation of interlayer excitons (IXs), long-lived dipolar excitations that provide an ideal setting for emergent collective phenomena. Here, we engineer an atomically thin light-emitting diode (LED) that generates electroluminescence (EL) from electrically injected IXs that are confined near the sample edges by an edge-enhanced fringing electric field. By measuring Hanbury-Brown-Twiss photon-photon correlations, we find pronounced signatures of collective decay in the form of large photon bunching followed by finite delay antibunching and bunching revivals. These emitter correlation signatures disappear when free charge carriers are doped to form a degenerate Fermi sea but are enhanced by the introduction of localized electrons. The results are consistent with a many-body quantum master equation that models the steady-state superradiant photon statistics of incoherently injected IXs. Our work establishes steady-state cooperative emission in a 2D TMD LED as a platform for studying strong light-matter interactions in electrically driven, non-equilibrium phases of Bose-Fermi mixtures.

summaries.en: Electrically injected interlayer excitons confined near the edges of an atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenide light-emitting diode exhibit steady-state cooperative emission, revealed by photon bunching with antibunching and bunching revivals in Hanbury-Brown-Twiss correlations that vanish under degenerate free-carrier doping but are enhanced by localized electrons.
summaries.zh: 在原子级薄的过渡金属硫族化合物发光二极管中，电注入的层间激子被限制在样品边缘附近，表现出稳态协同辐射，其Hanbury-Brown-Twiss光子关联呈现聚束后伴随有限延迟的反聚束与再聚束特征，这些关联在简并自由载流子掺杂时消失，而在引入局域电子时增强。
summaries.ja: 原子層遷移金属ダイカルコゲナイド発光ダイオードにおいて試料端付近に閉じ込められた電気注入層間励起子が定常的な協同発光を示し、ハンベリー・ブラウン・トゥイス光子相関に大きなバンチングと有限遅延後の反バンチングおよび再バンチングが現れ、これらの相関は縮退自由キャリアドープで消失するが局在電子の導入で増強される。

title: Correcting topographic artifacts in three-dimensional ToF-SIMS: A practical guide from data-only reconstruction to correlative AFM
abstract: Three-dimensional time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (3D ToF-SIMS) builds chemical volumes by stacking images acquired between sputter cycles. Standard reconstruction assumes a flat starting surface and a single sputter rate, so samples with topography, or with layers that sputter at different rates, yield distorted interface positions and depth scales. This article is a practical guide to correcting these artifacts. We group the available corrections by the information they need: the SIMS data alone, atomic force microscopy (AFM) topography before and after the profile, or AFM topography also at intermediate stages. All three are applied to a model Pt/TaOx/Ta/Pt/Ti crossbar memristor device measured with in situ SIMS/AFM at ten stages, together with the data preparation they share. Each correction method is evaluated using the known device geometry and the measured surface evolution. The data-only correction requires no additional instrumentation and restores relative topography, but its depth scale depends on nominal layer thicknesses and remains unconstrained below the last calibrated interface. AFM before and after the profile fixes the start and end surfaces but assumes uniform sputtering in between, which fails next to the device, where the surroundings change material during the profile. Multi-stage AFM correction follows these changes and reproduces the structure of the device, at the cost of instrument time and repeated imaging of a partially sputtered surface. A decision flowchart and a checklist help readers choose, validate and report a correction.

summaries.en: This practical guide shows that correcting topographic and differential-sputter-rate artifacts in 3D ToF-SIMS ranges from data-only reconstruction, which restores relative topography but leaves the depth scale unconstrained, to multi-stage AFM correction that follows surface and material changes and reproduces the device structure at the cost of extra instrument time.
summaries.zh: 本实用指南表明，3D ToF-SIMS 中形貌和不同溅射速率伪影的校正方法从仅用数据的重建（可恢复相对形貌但深度尺度不受约束）到多阶段 AFM 校正（可跟踪表面和材料变化并重现器件结构，但需额外仪器时间）。
summaries.ja: 本実用ガイドは、3D ToF-SIMSにおけるトポグラフィーとスパッタ速度差によるアーティファクトの補正が、相対的なトポグラフィーを復元するものの深さスケールが拘束されないデータのみの再構成から、表面と材料の変化を追跡してデバイス構造を再現する代わりに追加の測定時間を要する多段階AFM補正まで及ぶことを示す。

title: Is the Kaniadakis deformation of holographic dark energy detectable? A non-flat analysis with DESI DR2, cosmic chronometers and Pantheon+SH0ES
abstract: Kaniadakis entropy deforms the horizon entropy through a single parameter $K$, and the holographic dark energy built on it (KHDE) reduces to the standard model as $K\to0$. We ask whether current data can detect this deformation when spatial curvature is free and no cosmic-microwave-background calibration is assumed. Combining Pantheon+SH0ES supernovae, with the absolute magnitude fitted against the Cepheid calibrators, 32 cosmic-chronometer measurements of $H(z)$ and DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations with a free sound horizon, we find that non-flat KHDE fits the data as well as flat $\Lambda$CDM ($\Delta\chi^2=-2.1$ for three additional parameters) but leaves $K$ unconstrained: the profile $\chi^2$ changes by only $0.47$ between $K=0$ and its best value, and the bound $K<0.67$ (95%) reflects the validity domain of the model rather than the data. Information criteria therefore prefer $\Lambda$CDM ($\Delta\mathrm{AIC}=+3.9$, $\Delta\mathrm{BIC}=+20.2$). The joint fit gives $\Omega_{k0}=0.012\pm0.045$, three times tighter than supernovae alone, $H_0=72.04\pm0.85\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ and $r_d=139.34\pm1.76\,\mathrm{Mpc}$; chronometers and DESI alone prefer $H_0=68.17\pm1.93$, $2.4\sigma$ below the supernova value. In the fitted model, acceleration begins at $z_t=0.66\pm0.03$; a model-independent neural-network reconstruction of $H(z)$ from the chronometers gives a present-day deceleration parameter $q_0=-0.46\pm0.14$, consistent with the model. We also identify three analysis requirements which, if ignored, make the deformation numerically invisible, underestimate the $H_0$ uncertainty fourfold, or spuriously reject the model.

summaries.en: A joint analysis of Pantheon+SH0ES supernovae, 32 cosmic chronometers and DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations shows that non-flat Kaniadakis holographic dark energy fits the data as well as flat LambdaCDM but leaves the Kaniadakis parameter K unconstrained, so information criteria prefer LambdaCDM.
summaries.zh: 结合Pantheon+SH0ES超新星、32个宇宙钟和DESI DR2重子声学振荡的联合分析表明，非平坦Kaniadakis全息暗能量对数据的拟合与平坦LambdaCDM一样好，但Kaniadakis参数K无法被约束，因此信息准则更倾向于LambdaCDM。
summaries.ja: Pantheon+SH0ES超新星、32個の宇宙時計、DESI DR2のバリオン音響振動を組み合わせた解析により、非平坦Kaniadakisホログラフィック暗黒エネルギーは平坦LambdaCDMと同程度にデータを説明できるもののKaniadakisパラメータKは制約できず、情報量基準はLambdaCDMを優先することが示された。

title: Symmetry and Quantum Interference in the Attosecond Domain
abstract: In this review, we examine the interplay of symmetry and quantum interference in the attosecond domain primarily through one- and two-electron photoelectron momentum distributions. Using our own work, we discuss how tailored laser fields provide control over dynamical symmetries, and how quantum-orbit methods make it possible to connect the resulting momentum-space structures to specific ionisation, propagation, and rescattering pathways. Particular emphasis is placed on ultrafast photoelectron holography and nonsequential double ionisation through recollision excitation with subsequent ionisation, where several distinct forms of quantum interference can be identified and manipulated. We also discuss how target properties, including the binding potential, orbital symmetry and parity, modify this mapping. Finally, we consider emerging opportunities offered by non-classical states of light, for which photon statistics and quantum fluctuations provide additional degrees of freedom for controlling symmetry and strong-field electron dynamics.

summaries.en: This review examines how tailored laser fields control dynamical symmetries and quantum interference in one- and two-electron photoelectron momentum distributions in the attosecond domain, connecting momentum-space structures to ionization, propagation, and rescattering pathways via quantum-orbit methods, with emphasis on ultrafast photoelectron holography and nonsequential double ionization, and considers how target properties and non-classical light states modify or extend this control.
summaries.zh: 这篇综述通过单电子和双电子光电子动量分布，考察了阿秒域中对称性与量子干涉的相互作用，讨论了定制激光场如何控制动力学对称性以及量子轨道方法如何将动量空间结构联系到电离、传播和再散射路径，重点涉及超快光电子全息术和通过再碰撞激发随后电离的非顺序双电离，并探讨了靶特性以及非经典光态如何修饰或拓展这种控制。
summaries.ja: 本レビューは、単一・二電子の光電子運動量分布を通じてアト秒領域における対称性と量子干渉の相互作用を検討し、整形レーザー場による動的対称性の制御と量子軌道法による運動量空間構造の電離・伝播・再散乱経路への対応付けを論じ、超高速光電子ホログラフィーと再衝突励起を経る非逐次二重電離に重点を置きつつ、標的性質や非古典光状態がこの制御をどのように修飾・拡張するかを考察する。

title: Enhancing analytical photon transport in turbid media through physics-guided neural network corrections
abstract: Analytical methods provide rapid and computationally efficient predictions of light transport in turbid media, making them attractive for real-time and inverse applications. However, their accuracy is limited by the approximations and assumptions used to obtain tractable solutions. On the other hand, Monte Carlo (MC) simulation is widely regarded as the "gold standard" for modeling light transport in turbid media, but its high computational cost limits its use in applications requiring repeated forward evaluations. Here, we introduce a physics-guided residual learning framework that combines the computational efficiency of analytical modeling with the accuracy of MC simulation. As a representative case study, we consider the diffusion approximation (DA), which can exhibit systematic errors under relatively strong absorption, weak scattering, and imperfect boundary treatment. Given the absorption coefficient, scattering coefficient, and anisotropy factor, the corresponding DA prediction is incorporated as a physical prior, while the network learns only the residual between the analytical prediction and the MC reference. Across the evaluated optical-property range, the proposed framework reduces scalar-reflectance RMSE and spatially resolved reflectance RMSLE by factors of approximately 62 and 14, respectively, relative to the diffusion approximation. With only 1\% of the available training data, it achieves approximately 87\% and 93\% lower corresponding errors than a direct neural-network surrogate. These results demonstrate that learning corrections to an analytical physical baseline improves both prediction accuracy and data efficiency.

summaries.en: This paper introduces a physics-guided residual learning framework that uses the diffusion approximation as a physical prior and trains a neural network to learn only the residual between the analytical prediction and Monte Carlo reference, reducing scalar-reflectance RMSE and spatially resolved reflectance RMSLE by roughly 62 and 14 times, respectively, relative to the diffusion approximation while achieving high data efficiency.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种物理引导的残差学习框架，以扩散近似作为物理先验，让神经网络仅学习解析预测与蒙特卡罗参考之间的残差，相比扩散近似将标量反射率RMSE和空间分辨反射率RMSLE分别降低约62倍和14倍，并具有较高的数据效率。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、拡散近似を物理的事前情報として用い、ニューラルネットワークに解析予測とモンテカルロ参照の残差のみを学習させる物理誘導型残差学習フレームワークを提案し、拡散近似と比較してスカラー反射率のRMSEと空間分解反射率のRMSLEをそれぞれ約62倍および14倍低減するとともに高いデータ効率を実現する。

title: Gerchberg-Saxton Optimized Silicon Metasurface for Sinusoidal Structured-Light Three-Dimensional Imaging
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) optical imaging based on structured illumination has attracted considerable attention in applications including machine vision, robotics, and computational sensing. However, conventional structured-light systems generally rely on bulky projection components, such as digital micromirror devices and diffractive optical elements, which limit system miniaturization and integration. Here, we demonstrate a compact structured-light 3D imaging platform enabled by a silicon dielectric metasurface operating at a near-infrared wavelength of 940 nm. The desired sinusoidal fringe illumination is encoded into the metasurface through a Gerchberg-Saxton (GS) phase optimization algorithm, which converts the target far-field distribution into a nanoscale phase profile and subsequently into silicon nanopillar geometries. The fabricated metasurface generates high-quality sinusoidal structured illumination, which is integrated with a four-step phase-shifting reconstruction method to recover 3D object profiles. The proposed approach provides a compact and scalable solution for miniaturized structured-light projection and optical 3D sensing.

summaries.en: A silicon dielectric metasurface operating at 940 nm, designed via Gerchberg-Saxton phase optimization to generate sinusoidal fringe illumination and combined with four-step phase-shifting reconstruction, enables compact structured-light three-dimensional imaging.
summaries.zh: 通过Gerchberg-Saxton相位优化设计的940 nm硅介质超表面可产生正弦条纹照明，并结合四步相移重建方法实现紧凑的结构光三维成像。
summaries.ja: Gerchberg-Saxton位相最適化により設計された940 nmのシリコン誘電体メタサーフェスが正弦波フリンジ照明を生成し、4段階位相シフト再構成と組み合わせることで、コンパクトな構造化照明三次元イメージングを実現する。

title: Shaping the spectra of second harmonic laser by spatial focusing
abstract: Accurately controlling the spectral width of second harmonic generation (SHG) is critical in applications such as nonlinear microscopy, ultrafast spectroscopy, and quantum optics, where tailored spectral properties are required. Although it is known that the focal length of the lens used to focus the pump beam influences the SHG spectrum, a simple and precise theoretical understanding of this effect has been lacking. Here, we develop a theoretical model to describe how pump focusing conditions affect SHG spectral broadening, and experimentally validate the model using BBO crystals with lenses of 50 mm and 200 mm focal lengths. Our results establish a practical method for engineering the SHG spectral width through pump focusing, providing valuable guidance for designing nonlinear optical systems with specific spectral requirements.

summaries.en: The paper develops and experimentally validates a theoretical model showing that the focal length of the lens focusing the pump beam controls the spectral broadening of second harmonic generation, enabling a practical method to engineer SHG spectral width.
summaries.zh: 该论文建立并通过实验验证了一个理论模型，表明聚焦泵浦光束所用透镜的焦距会影响二次谐波产生的光谱展宽，从而提供了一种调控二次谐波光谱宽度的实用方法。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、ポンプ光を集光するレンズの焦点距離が第二高調波発生のスペクトル広がりを制御することを示す理論モデルを構築し実験的に検証して、SHGスペクトル幅を設計する実用的手法を確立した。

title: Parallel Omnidirectional Atom Rearrangement with Dynamic Holograms
abstract: The ability to assemble and reconfigure individual atoms is central to performing quantum science using optical tweezer arrays. Here, we demonstrate parallel omnidirectional atom transport and rearrangement using dynamic holograms generated by a single kilohertz-rate spatial light modulator. By carefully characterizing survival and heating, we show that atoms remain confined even when successive holograms are commanded before the liquid crystal has settled, enabling significantly faster transport. To generate holograms in real time, we develop and implement a warm-start, weighted Gerchberg-Saxton algorithm that achieves performance comparable to neural-network methods without requiring any training. Combining these techniques, we assemble ytterbium atoms into a 2078-site kagome lattice with 99.0% mean filling. In addition, we demonstrate parallel transport between array layers, combining axial and transverse motion to reconfigure atoms in three dimensions. Our approach is readily adaptable to existing tweezer platforms and provides a method for large-scale SLM-based atom assembly as well as programmable three-dimensional control.
subjects: Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: Using a kilohertz-rate spatial light modulator with a warm-start weighted Gerchberg-Saxton algorithm, the authors achieve parallel omnidirectional transport and three-dimensional rearrangement of individual ytterbium atoms, assembling a 2078-site kagome lattice with 99.
summaries.zh: 作者利用千赫兹速率空间光调制器结合热启动加权Gerchberg-Saxton算法，实现了单个镱原子的并行全向输运与三维重排，并在液晶未完全稳定前更新全息图的情况下，组装出平均填充率达99.
summaries.ja: 著者らは、キロヘルツレートの空間光変調器とウォームスタート付き重み付きGerchberg-Saxtonアルゴリズムを用いてイッテルビウム原子の並列全方向輸送と三次元再配置を実現し、液晶が完全に整定する前にホログラムを更新しても平均充填率99.

title: Allight: A Perfect Photon Collector
abstract: Collecting photons from quantum emitters remains a key limitation in light-matter interaction because conventional lenses collect light only from one direction. Here, we introduce a perfect light collector by inverse-designing a surrounding dielectric structure that encloses the emitter to increase photon-collection efficiency toward unity. Decomposing the device into several refractive interfaces enables emission collection from the full 4$\pi$ solid angle with adiabatic reshaping into a collimated beam. We experimentally demonstrate, in two dimensions, the ray bending that collimates omnidirectional emission. Our collector transforms current paradigms for highly efficient photon collection from narrowband, cavity-based techniques into experimentally robust, broadband, non-resonant dielectric devices.

summaries.en: The paper introduces Allight, an inverse-designed surrounding dielectric structure that collects omnidirectional emission from a quantum emitter over the full 4π solid angle and adiabatically reshapes it into a collimated beam, achieving near-unity photon-collection efficiency in a broadband, non-resonant, experimentally robust device demonstrated in two dimensions.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了Allight，一种通过逆向设计包围发射器的介质结构，能够从完整的4π立体角收集量子发射器的全向发射并将其绝热整形为准直光束，从而在宽带、非共振且实验稳健的介质器件中实现接近 unity 的光子收集效率，并在二维实验中得到了验证。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、量子エミッタを囲む誘電体構造を逆設計したAllightを提案し、全4π立体角からの全方位発光を収集して断熱的にコリメートビームへ整形することで、広帯域・非共鳴で実験的に堅牢な誘電体デバイスにおいて光子収集効率を1に近づけ、二次元で実証した。

title: Controlling Optical Quantum Interference with Plasmonic Metasurfaces
abstract: The ability to efficiently control optical quantum interference by the same device is a challenging task that promises to enable key operations in quantum information processing. Here, we tackle this problem by presenting a composite quantum plasmonic metasurface operating as an ultrathin non-unitary beamsplitter capable of achieving both single photon bosonic bunching and fermionic anti-bunching interference just by varying the incident photons frequency or changing the design dimensions. The presented metasurface combines a plasmonic grating corrugated by periodic nanoslits that can achieve extraordinary optical transmission with additional nanostripes on top forming nanocavities characterized by localized gap plasmon resonances. The photon-photon interactions are analyzed based on calculating the quantum coalescence metric which accurately portrays the obtained bunching or anti-bunching quantum interference. The presented quantum interference operation is applicable to both fundamental non-classical light interactions and in the design of more applied quantum optical logic gates used in quantum computing and communications.

summaries.en: A composite quantum plasmonic metasurface acting as an ultrathin non-unitary beamsplitter can switch between single-photon bosonic bunching and fermionic anti-bunching interference by varying the incident photon frequency or the design dimensions.
summaries.zh: 一种复合量子等离激元超表面作为超薄非酉分束器，可通过改变入射光子频率或设计尺寸，在单光子玻色聚束与费米反聚束干涉之间切换。
summaries.ja: 複合量子プラズモニックメタサーフェスは超薄非ユニタリービームスプリッターとして機能し、入射光子の周波数や設計寸法を変えることで、単一光子のボソン的バンチングとフェルミオン的反バンチング干渉を切り替えられる。

title: The optical force on a dielectric slab
abstract: Radiation-pressure forces on transmissive optics, including dynamical backaction, are usually computed from the momentum flux of the external fields. For a dielectric of finite thickness, this omits the time dependence of the electromagnetic momentum stored inside. We compute the force on a lossless dielectric slab of arbitrary thickness $L_s$ submerged in a dielectric fluid, proceeding from both Lorentz force on its bound charges and from the external momentum fluxes for arbitrary carrier and sideband fields. We treat the surrounding medium through a prescribed linear dielectric response and do not model the accompanying mechanical response of the fluid, including pressure and electrostriction. These two methods both recover the expected force in the limit of a thin reflector, but differ in the more general case by the rate of change of the field momentum stored in the slab. This storage term vanishes for static fields and at low frequencies reduces to $(L_s/c^2)\,dP/dt$, where $P$ is the net power through the slab. In a cavity, where $P$ depends on the slab position, the storage term produces a velocity-dependent force. The Abraham and Minkowski momentum formulations applied to the storage term are reconciled to give an unambiguous force on the dielectric in the case of an exterior vacuum environment, where there is no fluid response to model.

summaries.en: For a lossless dielectric slab of arbitrary thickness in a dielectric fluid, the force computed from the Lorentz force on bound charges and from external momentum fluxes agree in the thin-reflector limit but differ generally by the rate of change of field momentum stored in the slab, a term that vanishes for static fields, reduces to (L_s/c^2)dP/dt at low frequencies, produces a velocity-dependent force in a cavity, and reconciles the Abraham and Minkowski formulations for an exterior vacuum environment.
summaries.zh: 对于浸在介电液体中、厚度任意的无损耗介质板，由束缚电荷所受洛伦兹力计算出的力与由外部动量通量计算出的力在薄反射镜极限下一致，但在一般情况下相差一个板内存储场动量的变化率项，该项在静态场下为零，在低频下化为 (L_s/c^2)dP/dt，在腔中产生依赖速度的力，并在外部为真空环境时调和了Abraham与Minkowski两种动量表述。
summaries.ja: 誘電体液体中に浸した任意厚さの無損失誘電体スラブについて、束縛電荷に働くローレンツ力から求めた力と外部運動量流束から求めた力は薄い反射体の極限では一致するが、一般の場合にはスラブ内部に蓄積された場の運動量の変化率だけ異なり、この項は静的場では消え、低周波では (L_s/c^2)dP/dt に帰着し、共振器中では速度依存の力を生み、外部が真空の環境ではアブラハムとミンの運動量の定式化を調和させる。

title: Time-resolved Rydberg dynamics in molecules
abstract: We develop a general theoretical framework for the ultrafast dynamics of coherently populated autoionizing Rydberg states in molecules, whose coherent decay results in asymmetric Fano line shapes produced by interference between resonant autoionization and direct ionization. The asymmetric line shapes form in the photoelectron continuum during the autoionization lifetime of the decreasing Rydberg population. By parameterizing autoionization resonances and solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation, we model the buildup of the Fano profile together with the decline of the coherently excited Rydberg-state population. We compare our calculated photoelectron yields with the XUV-pump--IR-probe photoemission experiment of Biswas et al., Phys. Rev. A 110, 043106 (2024), in which neutral ground-state CO$_2$ molecules are excited by an XUV pulse to the Henning sharp and diffuse Rydberg series and subsequently ionized by the delayed IR pulse. Based on our numerically modeled photoelectron yields, we analyze two complementary processes: (i) photoemission into the $X^2\Pi_g$ continuum of residual CO$_2^+$ ions, which exposes interferences between direct photoionization and excited-state autoionization, and (ii) IR-induced photoemission into the CO$_2^+$[$B^2\Sigma_u^+$] continuum, which reveals quantum beats between Rydberg states. Our close-coupling model provides a versatile, extendable framework for tracking molecular Rydberg-state relaxation and, more generally, light-driven coherent dynamics in complex quantum systems.
subjects: Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph) ; Atomic and Molecular Clusters (physics.atm-clus)

summaries.en: A close-coupling theoretical framework models the ultrafast buildup of asymmetric Fano line shapes and the decay of coherently excited molecular Rydberg states, reproducing XUV-pump–IR-probe photoelectron yields from CO2 and revealing direct-ionization–autoionization interference and Rydberg-state quantum beats.
summaries.zh: 一个紧耦合理论框架模拟了分子中相干激发的里德堡态超快衰变过程中不对称法诺线型的形成，并与CO2的XUV泵浦–IR探测光电子产额实验相符，揭示了直接电离与自电离的干涉以及里德堡态间的量子拍。
summaries.ja: 強結合理論の枠組みにより、分子のコヒーレントに励起されたリュードベリ状態の超高速減衰に伴う非対称ファノ線形の形成をモデル化し、CO2のXUVポンプ・IRプローブ光電子収量を再現して、直接電離と自動電離の干渉およびリュードベリ状態間の量子ビートを明らかにした。

title: Dynamics of thermalization in classical three-dimensional many-body systems: Non-Maxwellian distributions and the role of anisotropic trapping
abstract: The physics of interacting baths is of interest in a variety of contexts, ranging from ultracold atoms to ionized gases. While many features can already be captured in a one-dimensional model, others are specific to the situation of two or three-dimensional systems. In this paper, we focus on three-dimensional features of a model for thermalization between two baths that we have explored in earlier publications. In contrast to the one-dimensional situation we show that, en route to thermalization, deviations from the Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distributions more akin to $\kappa$-distributions are observed. In three dimensions, these can be seen in changes at the peak of the distribution, which is precluded by the expected monotonic behavior of the energy distributions in one dimension. Furthermore, we consider thermalization for anisotropic trapping and explore its role in the onset of anomalous scaling with respect to the particle number. These results may be pertinent to the understanding of the interplay between turbulent behavior and nonlinearities for a variety of many-body classical systems.
subjects: Plasma Physics (physics.plasm-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Computational Physics (physics.comp-ph)

summaries.en: This paper shows that in a classical three-dimensional model of thermalization between two baths, the energy distributions develop non-Maxwellian, kappa-like deviations visible as changes at the peak, and that anisotropic trapping plays a role in the onset of anomalous scaling with particle number.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，在经典三维双浴热化模型中，能量分布会出现偏离麦克斯韦分布、类似κ分布的特征，表现为分布峰值的改变，并且各向异性束缚在粒子数异常标度的出现中起作用。

title: Generation of non-Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distributions during thermalization of interacting baths
abstract: We report on numerical experiments of thermalization between two reservoirs in which interspecies interactions are mediated via a Hamiltonian with a Gaussian dependence upon the distance between the particles. By using relatively high statistics, we are able to study deviations from the initially imprinted Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distributions as a function of the range and strength of the interaction, as well as the parameters of the two baths such as masses, trapping frequencies, that strongly affect the spatial overlap of the two species. At large interaction strengths and for any range, deviations are attributable to the sudden conversion of latent interaction energy into kinetic energy of the particles. In addition, long range interactions generate deviations even for interaction strengths in the weak regime, and non-uniform confinement introduces a further source of deviation from the Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distribution. This latter results in transient two temperature Maxwell-Boltzmann distributions suggestive of an inverse cascading route from inter-particle dynamics to thermalization. In the weakly-interacting regime, a simple expression for the equilibrium temperature is also obtained and discussed. These findings may be of relevance in the dynamics of exothermic chemical reactions, in the physics of ultracold atomic mixtures, and in self-sustained burning plasmas.
subjects: Plasma Physics (physics.plasm-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Computational Physics (physics.comp-ph)

summaries.en: Numerical simulations of two thermalizing reservoirs with Gaussian interspecies interactions show that strong interactions produce non-Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distributions through sudden conversion of latent interaction energy into kinetic energy, while long-range and non-uniformly confining interactions cause deviations even in the weak regime, including transient two-temperature distributions suggestive of an inverse cascading route to thermalization.

title: Nanophotonic Extreme Ultraviolet Polarimeter
abstract: Nanophotonic engineering has revolutionized how we manipulate the polarization of visible light. Here, we extend such control to extreme ultraviolet radiation, the spectral region of attosecond science and semiconductor lithography, where transmissive optical elements are lacking. We implement channel waveguides that restrict incident 41-nm-wavelength light to a few modes with defined spatial profiles and propagation constants. By designing the propagation-length-dependent interference of two eigenmodes, we achieve polarization-dependent forward scattering, which we exploit to create a transmissive nanophotonic analyzer that resolves the polarization axis and spectrum of extreme ultraviolet light from a single measurement. With a 0.9°-sensitivity for polarization rotations in a 1-second measurement and single-shot capability, the device opens new experimental opportunities in ultrafast magneto-optic spectroscopy and at accelerator-based light sources.

title: From random patterns to nanophotonic structures: Electromagnetic field prediction without retraining
abstract: Electromagnetic surrogate solvers can accelerate nanophotonic design, but their broader use requires accurate predictions for unseen geometries and material arrangements. Training on random dielectric patterns enables direct prediction of complex electromagnetic fields in diverse two-dimensional nanophotonic structures without retraining. The network takes spatial permittivity distributions as inputs, with training samples drawn from a dataset comprising 700,140 combinations of 5,001 random freeform dielectric patterns and 140 relative permittivities from 2.1 to 16.0. The trained model predicts fields for aperiodic bar arrays, manually defined patterns, inverse-designed metalenses, inverse-designed binary structures, and two-material freeform patterns excluded from training. Across 35,441 geometry-permittivity samples, a dilated residual network achieves average relative field errors of 1.4%-7.6%. For 6,950 inverse-designed metalens samples, the three most accurate architectures predict transmitted power with median relative errors of 0.7%-0.9%. Accuracy depends on refractive index and structural scale, with greater errors for patterns coarser than those used for training. These results demonstrate transfer to independently constructed geometries and to new spatial arrangements of dielectric values not represented in the training. Random-pattern training therefore supports reuse of electromagnetic surrogates across multiple structural families, providing a basis for sharing training costs among material screening, iterative optical design, and fabrication-tolerance analysis.

title: Controlling exceptional points of layered non-Hermitian structures with magnetic field
abstract: Exceptional points are the characteristic features of non-Hermitian systems providing numerous applications in optics, acoustics, electronics, etc. We show that exceptional points can be controlled with the external magnetic field by considering the archetypal three-layered $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric photonic structure including a magneto-optic material between the loss and gain layers. Application of the magnetic field makes the system anisotropic with the polarization-sensitive reflection and transmission properties. As a result, the magnetic field can stimulate $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetry breaking and mode exchange at realistic values of system parameters. Moreover, we suggest that the proposed scheme can be also used for magnetic-perturbation sensing with an easily adaptable level of desired field strength. Our results contain a valuable evidence for the usefulness of anisotropic (including magnetic) materials for tunable non-Hermitian photonics.

summaries.en: By placing a magneto-optic material between the loss and gain layers of a three-layer PT-symmetric photonic structure, the external magnetic field makes the system anisotropic with polarization-sensitive reflection and transmission, enabling control of exceptional points, stimulation of PT-symmetry breaking and mode exchange at realistic parameters, and magnetic-perturbation sensing.
summaries.zh: 通过在三层PT对称光子结构的损耗层与增益层之间加入磁光材料，外加磁场使系统呈各向异性并具有偏振敏感的反射和透射特性，从而能够在实际参数下调控奇异点、诱导PT对称破缺与模式交换，并可用于磁扰动传感。
summaries.ja: 損失層と利得層の間に磁気光学材料を挟んだ3層のPT対称フォトニック構造において、外部磁場が系を異方性にし偏光依存の反射・透過特性を与えることで、現実的なパラメータで例外点の制御、PT対称性の破れとモード交換の誘起、さらには磁気摂動センシングが可能となる。

title: Second-order difference-frequency effects on floating wind turbine responses: full-QTF modelling and experimental comparison
abstract: Accurate prediction of low-frequency responses is important for the dynamic assessment of floating offshore wind turbines (FOWTs), as second-order difference-frequency wave loads can contribute substantially to platform motions and mooring loads. Their relative importance, however, remains less well established when aerodynamic and hydrodynamic low-frequency excitations coexist under operating conditions. This study develops an efficient time-domain formulation for full difference-frequency quadratic transfer function (QTF) loading using bandwidth truncation and integrates it into a fully coupled model of the IEA 15 MW turbine on the VolturnUS-S semi-submersible platform. Numerical predictions are compared with 1:70-scale real-time hybrid wave-basin experiments covering both irregular wave-only and combined turbulent wind-wave conditions. Three hydrodynamic formulations are compared: linear wave excitation, Newman's approximation, and the full-QTF model. Under wave-only conditions, second-order difference-frequency loading substantially improves the prediction of surge and the associated mooring response, particularly in energetic sea states, with the full-QTF model generally providing the closest agreement with measured low-frequency spectra and peak-amplitude distributions. Under combined wind-wave conditions, low-frequency thrust fluctuations dominate near rated wind speed, reducing the relative importance of difference-frequency wave excitation, whereas its contribution becomes more apparent at higher wind speeds as thrust fluctuations diminish. Overall, the full-QTF model provides the most consistent improvement over the linear and Newman models, with maximum surge standard deviation discrepancy from measurement under the most energetic wave conditions less than 18%, with smaller discrepancies for heave, pitch, and mooring tensions.

summaries.en: This study develops an efficient time-domain full difference-frequency QTF formulation, integrated into a fully coupled IEA 15 MW VolturnUS-S model and validated against 1:70-scale hybrid experiments, showing that second-order difference-frequency loading substantially improves surge and mooring predictions in wave-only conditions but becomes less important near rated wind speed under combined wind-wave conditions where thrust fluctuations dominate.
summaries.zh: 本研究提出了一种高效的全差频QTF时域建模方法，并将其集成到IEA 15 MW风机与VolturnUS-S半潜平台的完全耦合模型中，通过与1:70缩比实时混合波浪水池实验对比发现，二阶差频载荷在纯波浪条件下显著改善纵荡和系泊响应预测，但在风浪联合条件下接近额定风速时低频推力波动占主导而使其相对重要性降低。
summaries.ja: 本研究は効率的な時間領域の完全差周波QTF定式化を開発し、IEA 15 MW風車とVolturnUS-S半潜水式プラットフォームの完全連成モデルに統合して1:70縮尺のハイブリッド水槽実験と比較し、波浪のみの条件では二次差周波荷重がサージと係留応答の予測を大幅に改善する一方、風波共存条件では定格風速付近で推力変動が支配的となりその相対的重要性が低下することを示した。

title: Enhanced orbital-angular-momentum dimensionality and spatial-spectral decoupling in thin-film SPDC
abstract: Thin-film spontaneous parametric down-conversion, due to the relaxed phase-matching condition, generates photon pairs that are extremely broadband in frequency and angle and highly entangled in time/frequency and position/momentum. Here we show that it also provides a very broad orbital angular momentum (OAM) spectrum, which, in contrast to the case of bulk crystals, is decoupled from the frequency spectrum. To demonstrate it experimentally, we generate photon pairs in a $7~\mu\mathrm{m}$-thick lithium niobate film and compare them with those from a $500~\mu\mathrm{m}$-thick periodically poled lithium niobate crystal under identical pump conditions. The thin-film source exhibits a substantially broader OAM spectrum, with the azimuthal Schmidt number almost 9 times larger than that of the bulk source. On this highly entangled state, we perform quantum-state tomography in selected two- and four-dimensional OAM subspaces, demonstrating high-purity maximally entangled states. These results highlight thin nonlinear films as a promising platform for high-dimensional quantum-state generation with weak spatial--spectral coupling.

summaries.en: Thin-film spontaneous parametric down-conversion in a 7-μm lithium niobate film produces photon pairs with a much broader orbital-angular-momentum spectrum that is decoupled from the frequency spectrum, yielding an azimuthal Schmidt number about nine times larger than that of a 500-μm periodically poled bulk crystal and enabling high-purity maximally entangled states in two- and four-dimensional OAM subspaces.
summaries.zh: 在7微米厚的铌酸锂薄膜中，自发参量下转换产生的光子对具有更宽的轨道角动量谱，且该谱与频谱解耦，其方位角施密特数约为500微米厚周期极化体晶体的九倍，并可在选定的二维和四维OAM子空间中实现高纯度的最大纠缠态。
summaries.ja: 7μm厚のニオブ酸リチウム薄膜における自発パラメトリック下方変換は、周波数スペクトルから分離された非常に広い軌道角運動量スペクトルを持つ光子対を生成し、方位角シュミット数は500μm厚の周期分極バルク結晶の約9倍に達し、2次元および4次元のOAM部分空間において高純度の最大エンタングル状態を実現できる。

title: Attosecond Quantum Optical Spectroscopy of Topological Materials
abstract: High-harmonic generation (HHG) provides an ultrafast probe of quantum materials, yet conventional spectral observables do not generally furnish a common signature of band topology. Here we show that quantum-light-driven HHG opens an additional information channel through the photon statistics of the emitted harmonics. Using the Haldane Chern insulator and the time-reversal-invariant Kane-Mele topological insulator, we calculate helicity-resolved equal-time intensity correlations and identify a common enhancement of high-order harmonic correlations in the topological phases. For the Haldane model, a dichroic correlation constructed from opposite helicity channels reverses sign with the Chern number. These signatures originate from the distinct nonlinear response sampled by quantum fluctuations of the driving field and are absent from the corresponding mean harmonic spectra as a common classifier. Our results establish photon-correlation spectroscopy as a route to interrogate topological matter with quantum light and provide a bridge between strong-field solid-state physics and quantum optics.

summaries.en: Quantum-light-driven high-harmonic generation reveals a common enhancement of high-order harmonic intensity correlations in both the Haldane Chern insulator and the Kane-Mele topological insulator, with a helicity-based dichroic correlation in the Haldane model reversing sign with the Chern number, establishing photon-correlation spectroscopy as a route to probe topological matter with quantum light.
summaries.zh: 量子光驱动的高次谐波产生在Haldane陈绝缘体和Kane-Mele拓扑绝缘体中均揭示出高阶谐波强度关联的共同增强，且Haldane模型中基于螺旋度的二色性关联随陈数反号，从而确立了光子关联光谱学作为用量子光探测拓扑物质的新途径。
summaries.ja: 量子光駆動の高調波発生により、Haldaneチェン絶縁体とKane-Meleトポロジカル絶縁体の双方で高次高調波の強度相関が共通して増強され、Haldane模型ではヘリシティに基づく二色性相関がチャーン数に応じて符号反転することが示され、光子相関分光が量子光でトポロジカル物質を探る手法となることが確立された。

title: Quantum Limits of Blind Superresolution Imaging
abstract: Quantum estimation has shown that spatial-mode measurements can avoid Rayleigh's curse, but the fundamental precision limits are usually formulated for a known point-spread function (PSF). We show that, for two equally bright incoherent sources sharing an unknown static, shift-invariant complex-amplitude response, the local quantum information for separation is exactly the same as in the known-PSF case. In a quantum semiparametric formulation, the equality follows from the orthogonality of the separation score to the nuisance tangent space generated by all admissible PSF perturbations. We propose two receivers to access this information: momentum-resolved Hong--Ou--Mandel interference (MR-HOM), which acquires half the small-separation quantum information per signal photon without reconstructing the PSF, and a tomography-assisted symmetric logarithmic derivative receiver (TA-SLD), which asymptotically attains the full bound under explicit recovery conditions. These results provide a route toward blind superresolution without prior PSF calibration in microscopy, astronomy, and other optical imaging systems with uncertain responses.

summaries.en: For two equally bright incoherent sources sharing an unknown static shift-invariant complex-amplitude response, the local quantum information for separation equals that of the known-PSF case, and two proposed receivers—momentum-resolved Hong–Ou–Mandel interference and a tomography-assisted symmetric logarithmic derivative receiver—can access this information without prior PSF calibration.
summaries.zh: 对于共享未知静态平移不变复振幅响应的两个等亮度非相干光源，其间距的局域量子信息与已知点扩散函数情形完全相同，而所提出的动量分辨Hong–Ou–Mandel干涉接收机和层析辅助对称对数导数接收机可在无需事先标定点扩散函数的情况下获取这一信息。
summaries.ja: 未知の静的シフト不変な複素振幅応答を共有する等輝度の二つのインコヒーレント光源について、間隔に関する局所量子情報は既知のPSFの場合と完全に同一であり、提案する運動量分解Hong–Ou–Mandel干渉受信機とトモグラフィ支援対称対数導関数受信機はPSFの事前校正なしにこの情報へアクセスできる。

title: Dual Transverse Vortex-Spin-Momentum Locking in Rotating-Wave Structured Light
abstract: We theoretically investigate the transverse Poynting momentum and transverse spin angular momentum in circularly polarized rotating-wave structured light, and reveal a pair of \emph{dual} transverse vortex-spin-momentum locking. The transverse Poynting momentum exhibits a $\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetric locking structure, being controlled independently by either the polarization or vortex handedness, yet invariant under their simultaneous reversal. Meanwhile, the transverse spin angular momentum is independent of the polarization but endowed with a crucial vortex-dependence inheriting such vortex-dependence from the Poytning momentum via curl operation. This finding expands the understanding of transverse optical linear and angular momenta in structured light and opens a new paradigm for vortex-spin-controlled optical manipulation.

summaries.en: This theoretical study reveals dual transverse vortex-spin-momentum locking in circularly polarized rotating-wave structured light, where the transverse Poynting momentum shows Z2×Z2 symmetric locking controlled independently by polarization or vortex handedness and invariant under simultaneous reversal, while the transverse spin angular momentum is polarization-independent but inherits vortex dependence from the Poynting momentum via a curl operation.
summaries.zh: 这项理论研究揭示了圆偏振旋转波结构光中的双重横向涡旋-自旋-动量锁定：横向坡印廷动量呈现Z2×Z2对称锁定结构，可分别由偏振或涡旋手性独立控制，且在二者同时反转时保持不变；而横向自旋角动量与偏振无关，但通过旋度运算从坡印廷动量继承了对涡旋的关键依赖。
summaries.ja: 本研究は円偏光回転波構造光における双対的な横方向渦-スピン-運動量ロッキングを理論的に明らかにし、横方向ポインティング運動量がZ2×Z2対称なロッキング構造を示して偏光または渦の巻き方向のいずれかで独立に制御され両者を同時に反転すると不変である一方、横方向スピン角運動量は偏光に依存せず回転演算を通じてポインティング運動量から渦依存性を受け継ぐことを示した。

title: Mechanically reconfigurable layered GRIN lenses for mid-infrared
abstract: This paper presents a concept of mechanically adjustable planar Gradientindex (GRIN) lens that can be used to realize reconfigurable focusing at mid-infrared (mid-IR) or millimeter-wave (mm-wave) frequencies. The concept is based on a multilayer design rooted in effective medium theory, where spatial refractive index profiles are synthesized using first-kind Chebyshev polynomials. Symmetric lateral displacement of the layers enables continuous modulation of the effective refractive index distribution, allowing controlled transitions between divergent, afocal, and convergent wavefronts. Numerical simulations demonstrate accurate focal tuning at mid-IR and mm-waves. In the mid-IR regime, focal lengths of about 56 {\mu}m and 24 {\mu}m are achieved with relative errors of around 4.4% and 10%, respectively. In the mm-wave regime, the lens produces focal lengths of about 158 mm and 128 mm with improved accuracies of 2.3% and 6.0%, respectively. The reconstructed refractive index profiles exhibit high similarity to ideal convex lens distributions, confirming the validity of the proposed synthesis approach. The proposed GRIN lens concept offers a scalable and physically interpretable approach to reconfigurable focusing, with potential applications in multimodal imaging, adaptive sensing, and telecommunication systems.

summaries.en: The paper presents a multilayer, mechanically reconfigurable planar GRIN lens based on effective medium theory and first-kind Chebyshev polynomial synthesis, in which symmetric lateral displacement of the layers continuously modulates the effective refractive index distribution to achieve tunable focusing at mid-infrared and millimeter-wave frequencies with demonstrated focal lengths and low relative errors.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种基于有效介质理论和第一类切比雪夫多项式合成的多层机械可重构平面GRIN透镜，通过层间的对称横向位移连续调制有效折射率分布，从而在中红外和毫米波频段实现可调聚焦，并展示了相应的焦距和较低的相对误差。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、有効媒質理論と第一種チェビシェフ多項式に基づく多層構造の機械的に再構成可能な平面GRINレンズを提案し、層の対称的な横方向変位により有効屈折率分布を連続的に変調することで、中赤外およびミリ波帯域において低い相対誤差で集束を調整できることを示した。

title: Cavity models of non-Abelian gauge theories
abstract: In quantum optics and related fields, cavity quantum electrodynamics provides a powerful framework for modeling the low-energy properties of bound charges coupled to electromagnetic fields, using a minimal set of atomic levels and isolated photonic modes. Here, we develop a similar framework for non-Abelian gauge theories, focusing on the pure-gauge dynamics of SU(2) fields as the conceptually simplest example. Starting from the corresponding Yang-Mills Lagrangian, we derive an SU(2) cavity Hamiltonian in the Coulomb gauge, represented in terms of only three localized bosonic modes. Unlike its non-interacting electromagnetic counterpart, this model exhibits a nontrivial excitation spectrum featuring bound composite gauge particles ('glueballs') as the lowest-energy configurations. We extend this framework to one-dimensional arrays of coupled SU(2) cavities and discuss the driven excitation of a glueball condensate and the clustering of multi-glueball states as two elementary interaction-induced processes in these models. These examples offer a glimpse into the multitude of novel many-body phenomena that arise within this cavity SU(2) framework and we show how this physics at the interface between particle physics and quantum optics can be experimentally explored using state-of-the-art superconducting quantum circuits.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; High Energy Physics - Lattice (hep-lat)

summaries.en: The authors derive an SU(2) cavity Hamiltonian in the Coulomb gauge from the Yang-Mills Lagrangian, reduce the pure-gauge dynamics to three localized bosonic modes whose lowest-energy excitations are composite glueballs, extend the model to one-dimensional arrays of coupled cavities, and propose probing driven glueball condensates and multi-glueball clustering with superconducting quantum circuits.

title: Rényi multi-entropy of graph states and the $n -> 1$ limit
abstract: Rényi multi-entropy extends the Rényi entropy to pure states of more than two parties. It is defined by a replica contraction at integer replica number $n$, and the multi-entropy is its $n\to1$ limit. In holography this limit is conjectured to compute the area of a minimal soap-film web in the bulk. Understanding multi-entropy for general states, however, is harder. Unlike the bipartite case, the replica contraction is not a moment of a density matrix, and the continuation to $n=1$ has to be found by other means. We study this problem for qubit graph states. We show that at every odd $n$ the contraction equals $2^{-k/2}$, where $k$ is a sum of ranks of matrices over a finite field, one row and one column per qubit. We define a class of graphs that we call collision-controlled, for which the rank sum is a polynomial in $n$. This class includes graphs without even cycles and all complete bipartite graphs. The natural polynomial $n \to 1$ continuation is a finite sum over partitions of the parties. While the Rényi multi-entropy is non-increasing under single-qubit Pauli measurements at every odd integer $n>1$, the continuation to $n=1$ is not. A $Z$ measurement on one qubit of an odd ring with $2r + 1 \geq 7$ qubits raises it from $(r+1)\log 2$ to $(2r-1) \log 2$. Thus the continuation is not an entanglement monotone.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th)

summaries.en: For qubit graph states, the Rényi multi-entropy is computed at odd replica numbers n as 2^{-k/2} with k a finite-field rank sum, and its polynomial n→1 continuation is a finite sum over partitions that is not an entanglement monotone, since a single-qubit Z measurement on an odd ring of 2r+1≥7 qubits raises it from (r+1)log 2 to (2r−1)log 2.

title: The next phase of quantum energy science: from mechanisms to applications
abstract: A growing research community spanning quantum batteries, molecular and excitonic energy transport, polaritonics, quantum materials and nuclear control has begun to describe its work in terms of quantum energy or quantum energy science. What connects these otherwise disparate efforts is the deliberate use of quantum states, couplings, collective effects and engineered environments to control energetic states and pathways. A key difference from quantum information science is that the complete quantum state does not always need to be preserved; engineered dissipation or dephasing can even improve the desired outcome. We organize this emerging domain through a framework that connects mechanisms, functions, capabilities, and applications. We identify five elementary functions (Excite, Hold, Release, Transfer, and Transform) and examine the mechanisms that implement them. The same functions recur from the molecular to the nuclear scale, although their relative implementation difficulty can differ sharply. Moving toward technology, we highlight three engineering capabilities (Storage, Routing, and Conversion) through the performance metrics that matter for their applications. Stretch scenarios illustrate what performance targets could make these capabilities technologically consequential.

summaries.en: This perspective organizes the emerging field of quantum energy science—spanning quantum batteries, molecular and excitonic energy transport, polaritonics, quantum materials and nuclear control—around a framework linking five elementary functions (Excite, Hold, Release, Transfer, Transform) to three engineering capabilities (Storage, Routing, Conversion) and their application-relevant metrics.

title: Comparative Optical Spectroscopy of Er$^{3+}$, Tm$^{3+}$, and Eu$^{3+}$ Molecular Complexes at Cryogenic Temperature
abstract: Rare-earth molecular complexes are attracting increasing interest for quantum information applications because of their structural flexibility and chemical tunability. Here, we compare the cryogenic optical properties of Er$^{3+}$, Tm$^{3+}$, and Eu$^{3+}$ complexes in the same ligand environment. Optical spectroscopy shows differing behavior across the three systems: spectral hole burning is observed in the Eu$^{3+}$ complex, whereas no measurable hole is detected in the Er$^{3+}$ and Tm$^{3+}$ complexes. We measure laser-induced local heating and rethermalization in the Er$^{3+}$ and Tm$^{3+}$ powder-like samples, observing strong local heating and slow thermal relaxation in the cold-plate cryostat. The recovery occurs over several seconds and, for some Er$^{3+}$ excitation conditions, extends over tens of seconds. The comparison across the three ions nevertheless suggests that heating alone is unlikely to account for the full contrast. Rather, the different behaviors of Eu$^{3+}$, Tm$^{3+}$, and Er$^{3+}$ point to ion-dependent relaxation and decoherence processes associated with their electronic level structure and coupling to the molecular environment. Temperature-dependent linewidth and line-shift measurements are further consistent with phonon-mediated broadening through coupling to crystal-field levels.

summaries.en: Cryogenic optical spectroscopy of Er3+, Tm3+, and Eu3+ complexes in the same ligand environment reveals spectral hole burning only for Eu3+, while Er3+ and Tm3+ show strong laser-induced local heating and slow rethermalization over seconds to tens of seconds, with temperature-dependent linewidths and line shifts consistent with phonon-mediated broadening and ion-dependent relaxation and decoherence tied to electronic level structure and molecular-environment coupling.

title: Field demonstration of a self-contained 10 km mobile-to-ground quantum network node via common-aperture co-propagation
abstract: In this work, we demonstrate a dual-function, common-aperture free-space optical system that simultaneously supports decoy-state BB84 quantum key distribution (QKD) at 803 nm and bidirectional classical laser communication at 640/660 nm over a 10.31 km terrestrial link from a mobile platform to a stationary ground station. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first field demonstration of a fully integrated common-aperture architecture where a co-propagating classical optical link simultaneously performs full QKD post-processing and ecrypted payload transmission over a 10 km atmospheric channel. The classical link utilizes Manchester-coded on-off keying (MC-OOK) at 10 MHz, achieving a packet error rate of $\sim$ 0.4 $\%$ (estimated bit error rate (BER) of 3.13 $\times$ 10$^{-5}$) with hardware-based self-synchronization and error-packet retransmission. Over the 10.31 km link, the QKD system achieved an average quantum bit error rate (QBER) of 2.512 $\%$ and an average secret key rate of 644 bps using rate-adaptive low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes. Finally, using the distilled keys, real-time AES-256 encrypted image transmission was executed over the co-aligned classical optical channel, proving the feasibility of a completely self-contained, jam resistant mobile quantum optical network.

title: Systematic Truncated Wigner Approximation for Open Spin Systems Reveals Long-Range Order Far from Equilibrium
abstract: Long-range interactions can protect dissipative order against fluctuations, but determining when they do so in two dimensions remains out of reach for existing many-body methods. We develop a continuous SU(2)-covariant truncated-Wigner framework that maps the problem onto stochastic dynamics with one Bloch sphere per site. Derived systematically from the exact Stratonovich-Weyl evolution of the Lindblad equation, it generates both drift and reservoir noise for arbitrary spin $S$. Benchmarks against exact and tensor-network calculations validate its description of non-equilibrium dynamics and steady states. Applied to 400-site two-dimensional dissipative anisotropic XY lattices, our method reveals physics missed by mean-field and perturbative approaches: vortex-antivortex proliferation destroys the predicted staggered-XY phase for nearest-neighbour coupling, whereas algebraically decaying interactions stabilize an extended $\mathbb{Z}_2$-ordered phase. We obtain the first beyond-mean-field steady-state phase diagram of the long-range interacting model, revealing reentrant loss of order at strong coupling and closure of the ordered region beyond $\alpha\approx 3.5$. Our new method provides a scalable route to strongly correlated driven-dissipative systems with long-range interactions, higher-dimensional geometries, spin-boson couplings, and spins beyond one half, relevant to modern experiments with magnetic atoms and polar molecules in optical lattices and tweezer arrays.

summaries.en: A systematically derived SU(2)-covariant truncated-Wigner method maps open spin systems onto stochastic Bloch-sphere dynamics and, applied to 400-site two-dimensional dissipative anisotropic XY lattices, reveals that long-range interactions stabilize a Z2-ordered phase where nearest-neighbour coupling instead succumbs to vortex-antivortex proliferation.

title: Engineering \(XY\) and \(ZZ\) interactions between two remote superconducting qubits via a multimode waveguide
abstract: Waveguides provide a flexible platform for long-range interactions between superconducting qubits. Here, we study how to engineer the effective \(XY\) and \(ZZ\) interactions between two qubits via qubit frequency assignments and multimode interference determined by the mode configuration and standing-wave parities of a finite multimode waveguide. For a single-mode waveguide, we find that \(XY\) and \(ZZ\) interactions cannot be simultaneously suppressed to zero and the residual qubit-qubit coupling always exists. For example, the \(XY\) interaction may be suppressed to a negligible level when two qubits and the waveguide mode satisfy the two-photon resonant condition, but the \(ZZ\) interaction cannot be switched off. For multimode configurations within the central dispersive window, the engineered interaction types are very different for odd and even numbers of modes. Even-mode configurations can readily produce strong \(XY\) interactions, whereas odd-mode configurations can strongly suppress the \(XY\) interaction while retaining a finite \(ZZ\) interaction. Full-Hamiltonian simulations of minimal two- and three-mode configurations confirm \(XY\)-dominated SWAP dynamics and \(ZZ\)-dominated CZ-type dynamics, respectively. These results establish a frequency assignment criterion of qubits and waveguide modes for selectively engineering long-range qubit-qubit interaction types induced by the waveguide with finite multimode.

summaries.en: By assigning qubit frequencies relative to the mode configuration and standing-wave parities of a finite multimode waveguide, effective XY- and ZZ-type interactions between two remote superconducting qubits can be selectively engineered, with even-mode configurations favoring strong XY interactions and odd-mode configurations suppressing XY while retaining a finite ZZ interaction.
